clusters.name: scaffold
clusters.executionModeRationale: Foundational scaffolding — every later cluster depends on this and the workspace edits. Must complete before any parallel work begins.

clusters.name: snapshot-reader
clusters.executionModeRationale: Read-only-tools and crew-tools clusters both depend on this single reader. Serialize as a dependency point so downstream parallel work uses a stable cache contract.

clusters.name: read-only-tools
clusters.executionModeRationale: Five read-only tools share schemas.ts and server.ts tool-registration sites; a single implementer ships them serially for review coherence and to avoid merge conflicts on the shared files. Could be split into five parallel sub-tasks if isolated wisely (one tool per branch with disjoint registration calls).

clusters.name: writers
clusters.executionModeRationale: US-004 (journal helper additive extension) and US-005 (set_override structured edit) touch disjoint exclusive files but share schemas.ts and server.ts. Can run in parallel with each other and with read-only-tools; coordinate the schemas.ts/server.ts touches via an early merge or serial check-in.

clusters.name: crew-tools
clusters.executionModeRationale: Within this cluster, US-006 (list_crew_sessions) builds the live-discovery cache that US-007 (get_transcript) reuses for sessionId resolution. US-008 (invoke_next) delegates to runWorkOnViaCrew from scripts/lib. Serialize US-006 → US-007; US-008 can run in parallel with US-007 once US-006 lands.

clusters.name: install-and-docs
clusters.executionModeRationale: Install script and final docs/INDEX refresh must run after all tools stabilize so the README accurately documents them and the INDEX reflects the final shape. Final atomic commit.
